confidence_notes: Holistic knowledge-based estimates, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain: July falls at the start of Busan's summer beach season, when Haeundae and Gwangalli rates rise, and rates vary widely by district and weekday. Cocktail and wine anchors are set from local price relationships to the draft beer anchor, not from direct price knowledge. Won-based prices are expressed in USD, so values will move with exchange rates. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors rest on general knowledge of South Korean price levels, with accommodation reflecting Busan's main visitor districts (Haeundae, Gwangalli, Nampo-dong) during early summer demand. Fukuoka, Japan, a comparable port-city tourism market, was considered only loosely.
